question: Can one per-image global residual dose maximize CB32 style subject to the unchanged image-space gradient budget, without local masks or safety-gate relaxation?

population.input_rail: legacy hash-bound encoded-sRGB JPEG display proxies; not RAW or scene-linear evidence

operator.full_target: exact CB32 origin-anchored 257-knot 1-Lipschitz fraction candidate after unchanged gamut-safe execution
operator.selection: first descending dose whose p99.9 RGB gradient magnitude is at most 1.35 times the source p99.9 gradient magnitude
operator.execution: one scalar dose for the whole image: CB11 + dose*(CB32-CB11), evaluated before encoding or review
operator.luminance: exact CB11 luminance because the residual is zero-luminance up to float32 reconstruction tolerance
operator.forbidden: continuous gate fitting, local dose, semantic mask, spatial filtering, per-channel dose, changed gradient metric or post-review rescue

stop_rules: Any automatic, dose-floor or style-salience failure closes this exact global-dose executor before visual review.
Do not densify the dose grid, lower the style floor or change the gradient metric on the consumed cohort.
A development pass requires separately frozen source-disjoint automatic and severe confirmation before any research-champion or product reconsideration.
claim_ceiling: Development-only gradient-budgeted global-strength evidence on the already consumed 40-row frozen cohort; not independent confirmation, complete face closure, stock response, calibration, population preference or product promotion.
